critique: The render has a plausible black-background fire/smoke palette: gray textured smoke surrounds the source and orange ember points expand noticeably from t1 to t4. However, the dominant form is a severely clipped, flat white circular core rather than readable orange/yellow flame. The smoke is a small, symmetric halo and the embers form a fairly uniform radial burst, making it read as a white explosion or energy orb more than the Smokey Fire preset thumbnail's flame-led, smoky character. Motion does expand between frames, but it grows the blown-out central disk rather than developing distinct fire and smoke structure.

suggestions.why: Replace Add blending with the less clipping-prone blend option so overlapping fire sprites retain orange/yellow flame detail instead of accumulating into a solid white disk.
Reduce particle accumulation at the emitter; the current 250 particles/sec produces an opaque, featureless center by frame 4.
Reduce the very large particle core so smoke texture and individual flame forms remain visible rather than merging into a hard circular mass.
